definitions.ask: Should plain `bob capture` refuse every email-task close until it is confirmed with the preview digest?
definitions.why: "Always" covers agents and terminals too; the refusal prints the exact rerun command.

definitions.ask: Should mouse and tap checkbox clicks on a Gmail Task in Live Preview and Reading view also open the card?
definitions.why: Clicks are the one common close gesture outside the keymaps; without this, "always" has a gap.

definitions.ask: Should a new decisions record "Closing A Gmail Task Asks First" be added to the decisions web?
